outcome: OpenAI direct BYOK provider implemented and verified locally.
usage: Settings > Image provider > OpenAI (direct) > paste an OpenAI API key and choose a GPT Image model.

implementation.imageEditing: POST https://api.openai.com/v1/images/edits with ordered multipart image[] references
implementation.credentials: Separate OpenAI key, sessionStorage by default; localStorage only with the existing remember-key opt-in.
implementation.routing: OpenAI keys never enter the Gemini SDK. Gemini-only planning is skipped; original prompts remain usable.
implementation.networkPolicy: api.openai.com allowed in source and emitted route CSP; service worker uses NetworkOnly.
implementation.errors: Localized auth, permission, billing, rate-limit and moderation messages; response bodies and keys are not included in provider errors.
implementation.legacyLimits: GPT Image 1.5 uses its supported square/portrait/landscape sizes. Painted masks retain the existing prompt/overlay fallback.
implementation.pricing: No fixed direct OpenAI cost assumed; no invented costUsd.

verification.gateWaivers: Retains the two existing focus-utility and React-mount waivers; no checker changes.
verification.scope: Browser requests were intercepted and mocked. Live key access, organization permissions and paid image quality were not tested.

deliveryAtVerification: Local working tree; not committed, pushed or deployed.
